## Governance review

- [ ] JavaScript source and bundled assets are consistent.
- [ ] Generated files have corresponding authored-source changes.

## Validation

- [ ] Package tests passed.
- [ ] `R CMD build` passed.
- [ ] Archive-based `R CMD check` passed; result:
- [ ] JavaScript `npm ci` and build passed where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation was regenerated where applicable.
- [ ] Screenshots are included only when UI behavior changed.
